title: Weekly Reset
concept: Scheduled maintenance meeting — appreciation, care audit, one friction, requests, alignment — not a trial.
whenToUse: Weekly same day/time; also after travel, stress, or distance. Not a fight forum — if flooded, Pause + Return first.
steps: Care Audit (10–15) — supported / alone; load fair?
Friction Review (10–15) — one small friction each; 2% Rule.
Requests — one specific ask each for next week.
Alignment — one next step + review time.

phrases.text: I felt supported when ___. Alone when ___.

working: Clean, time-boxed Reset ends with one device-free landing experiment and Sunday check. Issues stay small.
notWorking: Open with hot midweek content, no appreciation, no time-box. Maintenance becomes trial. Hot topics need repair container first.
activity: Calendar four weeks. Run 30-minute timer. Use the in-app Weekly Reset wizard.
